scientific_integrity: The explicit reliability polynomial is not claimed as new. The real-root positivity theorem is based on exact inequalities; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: One complete-bipartite family only; no classification of complex-root positions or their distinctness. Previously known reliability expression is cited. Highly relevant 2014 source was materially examined only through indexed theorem/expression; inaccessible full text and unindexed equivalent work remain originality risks. Finite checks do not replace the general proof.
title: The only real all-terminal reliability root of \(K_{3,n}\)
